en: Learner Tien, and you've tied this thing up
with an incredible match point.
I want to know in this unique format,
normally if you had lost a second set 6-2,
you wouldn't have much momentum going
into a third set.
In this case, it's just a tiebreaker.
After losing that second set,
do you feel like things just reset
because it's just a tiebreaker to 10?
Yeah, I mean, I think
in general I can reset pretty well mentally.
I think that's a big strength of mine,
but I think just in this format,
you know, no matter what the score
is, I think everyone still has a chance.
You know, the match can just turn
on a dime.
So I think just being able to put
the second behind me was really big today.
Tactically speaking,
did you change anything
in that third set tiebreaker?
I know this court is slow.
Did you just tell yourself, I'm gonna go
into lockdown mode and not miss?
Yeah, that's what my teammates told me
in between the second and third just to go
into lockdown.
And I was able to do it
for most of the breaker,
but there are some moments
where the ball just seems very enticing
to go for it.
But Taylor actually told me
that the 8-7 point was the first point
in the whole breaker that whoever
was on offense actually won the point.
So, yeah, I mean, just happy to get through.
In these stressful matches,
and that certainly was one at the end,
how much does it help you having
the great Andre Agassi on your bench
for your confidence?
It's amazing.
I mean, he's giving me more energy
than everyone else combined, maybe.
But it's great to have him there.
It's great just to have, you know,
a voice on the sidelines,
always encouraging you.
And I think just staying mentally calm
was very helpful.
Awesome. Well, well done today.
You've tied things up.
